speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes; to narrow down the cause of these concerning B symptoms, have you recently lost a significant amount of weight, and do you have a history of smoking?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of constitutional "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss) with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy and abdominal pain is highly suggestive of this malignancy. I will request a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis to assess for lymphadenopathy and organ involvement.
